item.title: Self-Hosted Data Masking and Anonymization: Greenmask vs Microsoft Presidio vs OpenRefine
item.description: Production databases contain sensitive information — personally identifiable information (PII), payment details, health records, and proprietary business data. When you need to share data with development teams, testing environments, or third-party analytics, exposing raw production data creates compliance risks and potential breach liability. This guide compares three self-hosted data masking and anonymization tools — Greenmask, Microsoft Presidio, and OpenRefine — to help you sanitize data before it leaves your production environment.
